      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Mr. Caffee_, Jul 21, 2026, 1/5: "Used to be a fantastic app, but the lag now is so bad. Especially at opening bell. I’ve reported, but no remedy. Many I’ve talked to say they experience the same. Additionally, the chats now are covered in spam while legitimate comments are flagged for the most confusing reasons. Sad, wish it could be like it used to."
            2. _MangyAnus_, Jul 14, 2026, 2/5: "Not sure what the issue is but this app is slow and often incorrect. I have to use other apps to track the market not too infrequently bc this one is broken or not updating. Today is a perfect example."
            3. _MacGeek1990_, Jul 25, 2026, 3/5: "If you have bad vision or low vision, it needs work. Does not display things well on an iPhone if you have the font set higher. This was not an issue on android"
